t: The LAP IP66 13A 2G weatherproof switched socket provides reliable outdoor power for various applications. It is ideal for gardens, workshops, and construction sites, ensuring safe electrical connections in challenging environments. This unit features IP66 protection, making it dust-tight and waterproof, and includes an LED neon indicator for clear power status. Its durable polycarbonate construction and lockable lid offer enhanced security and longevity. Multiple side and rear knockouts facilitate flexible installation, making it a practical choice for trade professionals.
